svg.text: Exact field groups behind the compact F1–F15 labels in the Level 0 DFD

g.text: F1
Access configuration and account status
User identity; account state; assigned role; organization; Purok/Barangay/City jurisdiction;
permission assignment; creator/authorizing account; effective time; resulting account/configuration status.
Control: no public registration. Barangay creates Purok accounts; DRRM creates Barangay accounts.
F2
Credentials and authorization result
Account identifier and authentication evidence; active/disabled state; authorized role;
organization/jurisdiction scope; allowed record states and actions; success/failure result.
Control: authentication never substitutes for record-level and jurisdiction-level authorization.
F3–F4
CDRA baseline and profile/hazard verification package
Geography; climate projection/scenario; hazard inventory, location, intensity, frequency/probability;
historical loss/damage; exposed population/assets; urban-use and natural-resource production areas;
critical facilities; lifeline utilities; vulnerable groups; sensitivity/vulnerability; adaptive/coping capacity;
risk score/map; facilities, equipment and resources; source/provenance; version; review/verification decision,
discrepancy, reason, correction request, reviewer/verifier and time.
Rule: CDRA is preparedness/planning baseline; it is not current incident-impact data.
F5–F7
Purok report, Barangay consolidation, and verification package
Incident reference/type; exact location; occurrence/discovery/report/as-of times; operational period; source;
chronology/narrative; affected population; displacement/evacuation; casualties; damaged houses,
infrastructure, agriculture and livelihoods; service/lifeline disruption; actions taken; assistance/resources;
needs/issues; attachments; included/excluded Purok versions; discrepancies; review/verification decision,
reconciliation, reason, reviewer/verifier and time.
Rule: submitted/verified versions are retained; corrections create linked versions.
F8–F9
SitRep source snapshot, review, approval, and export package
Eligible verified source versions at a fixed cut-off/as-of time; report number/type/version; incident chronology;
prevailing situation; affected population, displacement and evacuation; casualties; damage/loss; related incidents;
preparedness/response actions; assistance/resources; service status; issues/concerns/needs; recommendations;
source summary/provenance; unresolved discrepancies; review/correction decision; approver; approval/release time;
sanitized/public export state.
Supports Initial, Progress, Terminal, cumulative SitRep, and Final outputs—not one generic PDF.
Authorized query and result
Jurisdiction-scoped search/filter criteria; incident/profile/SitRep catalog; authorized source-linked records;
maps; time series; status counts; affected-population and impact totals; unresolved discrepancies;
approved SitRep exports.
Privacy: names, faces, precise personal details, casualty records, and attachments remain restricted and are
sanitized before publication. Access is logged.
Persistent record packages
F11: users, roles, account states, organizations, jurisdictions, assignments.
F12: CDRA profile versions, profile/hazard decisions, and source evidence.
F13: incident/report versions, review/verification decisions, and source evidence.
F14: SitRep source snapshot, version, review/approval decision, release/export state.
Audit event
Actor/account; role and jurisdiction; action; affected record and immutable version; prior state; new state;
decision/reason; timestamp; source IP/device/session where lawful; export/publication event.
Written by every state-changing process. Audit logging is not a separate user-initiated business process.

svg.text: RA 10121 §§3, 12 — disaster impacts; risk assessment/mapping; vulnerable groups; local hazard/vulnerability/climate-risk data; resources and critical infrastructure.
DHSUD CDRA Briefer and Supplemental Guidelines — hazard characterization, exposure database, vulnerability/sensitivity, adaptive capacity, maps, and risk scoring.
NDRRMOC SOPG 2024 pp. 52–55, 63 — Initial, Progress, Terminal, SitRep and Final reporting; source documentation; cumulative effects; geographically consolidated affected population.
Published NDRRMC SitReps: El Niño No. 44; SW Monsoon/TC Goring No. 04; TY Tisoy No. 15; TY Ambo No. 13 — actual field groups, numbering, and as-of presentation.
Project ZCDRRMO interview — chronology/narrative, variable operational periods, source limits, retained versions, verification, privacy sanitation, approval, and restricted access.
